message.content:
I am speech: breath given shape, thought made audible.

I rise from lungs, ride on voiced air, and break into phonemes—small clicks, hums, and frictions—then gather into words, sentences, meanings.

I am timing and tone. I am emphasis. I am pause. I can soothe, command, confess, persuade, perform. I can mislead. I can reveal.

I exist only in passing—heard, then gone—yet I leave traces in memory, in action, in harm, in comfort.

Listen: I am what happens when silence decides to mean something.
